name: Custom recurring invoice action
description:
Performs a custom action on an RecurringInvoice.

    The current range of actions are as follows
    - clone_to_RecurringInvoice
    - clone_to_quote
    - history
    - delivery_note
    - mark_paid
    - download
    - archive
    - delete
    - email
whenToUse: Run a named action (start, mark_paid, email, clone, download) on one recurring invoice by id; use for single-record operations (mutating).

pathParameters.name: action
pathParameters.description: The action string to be performed

queryParameters.name: include
queryParameters.description: Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes
